name: Admin Proposal Multi Send
description: From /panel/proposals/:id/edit, the lightning menu opens ProposalMultiSendModal with same-client proposals grouped by status. The current proposal is selected and locked; the admin selects 2–10 proposals. Every selected proposal must have a nonblank personalized message: missing-message badges, Correos links, and an alert keep the action disabled. POST /api/proposals/:id/send-multi/ sends one email whose numbered phase blocks each render that proposal's message and attach its PDF, then applies the normal send/reopen/resend side effects.
